_readme: Editable copy for the public page. Change wording here, not in build_dashboard.py. No dates and no client names in the scaling block. status is one of: live, in progress, planned.

status_note._readme: Shown under the headline carry. Clear 'text' to hide it.
status_note.text: Leverage paused. The Aave V4 Core hub's USDC rate keeps spiking around its kink (to 11% on 15 Oct), so KPK cut the loan to a light position and switched re-lever off. Full leverage resumes on the best-priced venue once the spread is reliably positive.

venue_copy._readme: Copy that depends on where the position is. The board reads the venue onchain and uses the block for it: aave_v4, aave_v3, or none (no loan open, the WBTC in the fund's Safe). A block's status_note replaces the one above; scaling_stages (by index) and scaling_backup update those entries; scope_cards updates the card with that value. status_note as_of 'auto' is the date of the move to Aave V3 Core; hide_when_relever drops the note once re-lever is on.

status_note.text: Loan closed. The Aave V4 Core hub's USDC rate stayed near 10%, above what the vaults earn, so the automatic negative-carry exit repaid the loan and returned the WBTC to the fund's Safe. Borrowing resumes on Aave V3 Core, where the spread is positive today.

0.adds: WBTC in the fund's Safe and the two KPK USDC vaults as the liquid sleeve; USDC was borrowed on the Aave V4 Core hub until 16 Oct, when the negative-carry exit closed the loan
0.needs: The move to Aave V3 Core, where the spread is positive today

Aave V4.detail: WBTC was collateral on the Bluechip spoke and USDC came from the Core hub until 16 Oct; the WBTC now waits in the fund's Safe.

Aave V3.label: Collateral and borrow
Aave V3.detail: Aave V3 Core: WBTC as collateral and USDC borrowed against it. The fund's next venue.

Merkl.detail: Pays the vault rewards, and paid the Aave V4 borrow rebate.

status_note.text: Moved to Aave V3 Core, where the spread is positive today. The loan starts as a small seed; KPK switches re-lever back on to return to the 1.21 target health factor.

0.adds: WBTC collateral and USDC borrowing on Aave V3 Core, and the two KPK USDC vaults as the liquid sleeve

1.adds: Spark as a second borrow venue, or USDG on the Aave V4 Core hub swapped to USDC; cbBTC as a second deposit asset; borrow sizing that reads rates and depth before drawing
1.needs: Agent support for Spark; the agent update that routes borrowing across venues

scaling_backup.text: Spark (strong for cbBTC), USDG on Aave V4 and Morpho, so the fund can move or spread its borrowing when one venue runs short of depth or turns expensive.

Aave V4.label: Previous venue
Aave V4.detail: WBTC collateral on the Bluechip spoke and USDC from the Core hub until 16 Oct; USDG there stays an option.

Aave V3.label: Collateral and borrow
Aave V3.detail: Aave V3 Core: WBTC as collateral and USDC borrowed against it.

Merkl.detail: Pays the vault rewards, and paid the Aave V4 borrow rebate.

Spark.detail: SparkLend: USDC borrowed against WBTC or cbBTC, once the fund's agents support it.

exit_causes._readme: What set off each exit-agent unwind, by transaction hash prefix: kpk when KPK triggered it, spread for the automatic negative-carry exit. The chain does not record which.

strategy_target_hf._readme: The health factor and band the strategy runs at in normal markets (before any de-risk). The borrow routes card, the risk wording and, while the fund isn't borrowing, the loop table and the simulator use them.

loop_sleeve.what: an optional syrupUSDG loop at up to 8x on the Aave V4 Maple spoke
loop_sleeve.share: a capped share of the borrowed stablecoins (25% to 50%) if it is switched on
loop_sleeve.limits: Leverage capped at 8x. When borrow costs rise above the loop's yield, the loop is partly unwound. The loop sleeve is never relied on to deleverage the BTC leg.

scaling.intro: The aim is to grow the fund safely and profitably. Each stage adds a borrowing source or a sleeve only once the depth behind it is there, and backup borrow venues mean no single venue caps the fund's size.

stages.adds: WBTC collateral on Aave V4 and the two KPK USDC vaults as the liquid sleeve; USDC was borrowed on the Core hub until 13 Oct, when its rate spiked
stages.needs: Borrowing resumes once a venue pays a positive spread

stages.adds: Borrowing on the best-priced venue: Spark or Aave V3 Core (deep USDC markets), or USDG on the Aave V4 Core hub swapped to USDC; cbBTC as a second deposit asset; borrow sizing that reads rates and depth before drawing
stages.needs: Permissions through the Security Council's 3-day timelock (in progress); the agent update that routes borrowing across venues

stages.adds: Larger lines across Aave and Spark; an optional syrupUSDG loop on the Aave V4 Maple spoke (about 25% of borrowed stables), only after depositors have run plain BTC deposits and redemptions; cirBTC as a deposit asset once Aave lists it
stages.needs: Venue capacity; Maple lender onboarding and NAV coverage for the loop; a cirBTC price feed for NAV

stages.adds: Morpho markets as another borrow venue, next to Aave and Spark
stages.needs: Venue integrations in the execution layer

backup.label: Backup borrow venues
backup.text: Aave V3 Core, Spark (strong for cbBTC) and Morpho. Their permissions are in the Security Council's 3-day timelock, so the fund can move or spread its borrowing when one venue runs short of depth or turns expensive.

milestones._readme: Shown on the share-price chart. Times are UTC. The deposit, seed borrow and re-lever come from the data; these are the events the data cannot name.

testing_phase.label: testing phase
testing_phase.note: KPK test deposits of 0.0002 to 0.0035 WBTC while the agents were set up and tested on the Prime hub

events.label: test deposits and a test redemption
test deposit minted at the last settled price
test debt repaid, debt moved to the Core hub

scope._readme: Cards under the intro, so a reader can scope the fund. status: live, next, planned or optional. A card with live_if 'maple' switches to live once the fund holds a position on the Aave V4 Maple spoke.

cards.label: Chain
cards.detail: All positions and contracts are on Ethereum; nothing runs on other chains.

cards.label: Collateral and borrow
cards.detail: WBTC as collateral on the Bluechip spoke; stablecoins borrowed from the Core hub (USDC so far, USDG planned).

cards.label: Borrow
cards.detail: Aave V3 Core: USDC borrowed against WBTC once its permissions clear the timelock.

cards.label: Borrow
cards.detail: SparkLend: USDC borrowed against WBTC or cbBTC, once its permissions clear the timelock.

cards.label: Liquid sleeve
cards.detail: KPK USDC Yield and KPK USDC Yield RWA, both curated by KPK.

cards.label: Rewards
cards.detail: Pays the Aave borrow rebate and the vault rewards.

cards.label: Fund contracts
cards.detail: Shares token, onchain NAV calculator, and a Safe that acts only through Zodiac Roles permissions.

cards.label: Loop sleeve
cards.detail: Optional: a syrupUSDG loop on the Aave V4 Maple spoke. Not active; the fund runs without it.

risk_controls._readme: Thresholds that live in the monitoring setup, which the board cannot read itself. Update the numbers and as_of when they change.
